evidence.detail: The interface extends the shared config contract and carries exact config-group key 'notifications'.
Its two exact sections are 'Alerts' / 'Configure things that alert notifications' and 'Settings' / 'The general settings for all notification alerts'.

Config items include de-aggro timer alerts, superior slayer/boss alerts, private-message alerts, tray icon, tray notifications, request focus, NotificationSound, timeout, FlashNotification, focused-client notification policy and flash color.
rs/s/n/b provides this exact config interface from ConfigManager and consults its alert toggles before dispatching messages through the already-owned R14 Notifier.

proposals.note: Descriptive SpawnPK exact-v308 name for the dedicated notifications/alerts config interface. No upstream source-name identity is claimed.

evidence.detail: The class extends the plugin base and its exact runtime descriptor is title 'Notifications', key 'notifications', tags ['notify','alert','notification'], hidden=true.
The plugin injects R14 Notifier and NotificationAlertsConfig and routes qualifying events to Notifier with TrayIcon message types.

Subscribed event handlers implement de-aggro timer notification, superior slayer/boss spawn notification and private-message notification according to the config toggles; focus change resets de-aggro alert suppression.
The class provides NotificationAlertsConfig directly from the shared ConfigManager, fixing the config/plugin pair within one notifications feature.
